subject: science
passage: In the hills of central Nepal, the red flowers of the tree rhododendron, Nepal's national flower, have long marked the arrival of spring. Botanist Prakash Gurung compiled records of first flowering at two sites in the Annapurna region, one at 2,000 meters above sea level, among terraced farmland, and one at 3,200 meters, in high forest. Gurung argues that although rhododendrons now bloom earlier at both elevations than they did in 1990, the shift has been far greater at the higher site, a pattern he attributes to faster warming at high elevations.

data.title: Average First Flowering Date of Tree Rhododendrons in the Annapurna Region

stem: Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to support Gurung's argument?

choices.A: At the lower site, rhododendrons first flowered earlier in 2020 than in any other year shown.
choices.B: In every year shown, rhododendrons at the higher site first flowered later in the year than those at the lower site.
choices.C: From 1990 to 2020, first flowering came 22 days earlier at the higher site but only 7 days earlier at the lower one.
choices.D: The gap between the first flowering dates at the two sites widened from 1990 to 2020.

explanation.why: Gurung's argument compares the size of the shift at the two sites: both now bloom earlier, but the higher site has shifted far more. Support must compare how much each line changed. A lower day number means earlier flowering: the higher site moved from day 128 to day 106 (22 days earlier), while the lower site moved from day 75 to day 68 (7 days earlier).
explanation.A: Incorrect. This is true, but it describes only the lower site and gives no comparison with the higher site.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This is true, but it is expected at a colder site and says nothing about how much flowering has shifted at each elevation.
explanation.C: Correct. It shows that flowering moved earlier at both sites and that the shift at the higher site was about three times as large.
explanation.D: Incorrect. The gap shrank from 53 days (128 − 75) to 38 days (106 − 68), so this reverses the graph.
